lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting semi-regular spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like arrangement where circular blobs serve as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlighted superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low density of small, high-luminance blobs is distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated within the anterior and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark, elongated silhouettes consistent with commensal fish (remoras) positioned near the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
